title: messaging: the approval Slack DM's link is built as origin + in-app path with no Console mount, so it likely opens the same 404 the approval e-mail did before #36247
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5krBqrrgxCYgjXmfbv

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · raised by area a4-B while landing PR #36247 (#34862). Read from source on main b57f778b18, not measured.

## What happens
`packages/services/service-messaging/src/slack-channel.ts:130-168`: `slackDmText` links the DM title to `absoluteLink(n.actionUrl, origin)`, which is `origin + actionUrl` when `actionUrl` is a path. For an approval, `actionUrl` is the in-app route `/system/approvals?request=ID`, which the Console routes on under its mount (`AuthConfig.uiBasePath`, default `/_console`). The DM link carries no mount, so on a default deployment it should land on the same "not found" page the approval e-mail link opened before #36247.

## Done when
- The Slack DM link opens the Console page under its mount, read from the same one source #36247 uses (the auth service's `getConsoleUrl` / `AuthConfig.uiBasePath`), not a new constant.
- A sub-path deployment is not prefixed twice (same rule as `consolePageLink`).
- Measured on a real `os dev` boot with a Slack sink or a captured DM payload: before / after link.
- Coordinate with #35844 (same function, origin source). One PR may take both; if so, say so on both cards.

reach: approvers who get approvals in Slack; read from source.
Business reason: the one link in the approval DM may open an error page.
Reader: service-messaging; plugin-approvals wiring.
Dedupe: `slack DM link console`, `slack-channel console mount`, `slack link 404` → only #35844 (origin, not mount; related, not the same).
Grade: p2.
